profile.headline: Software Development Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software developer with an extensive background in game development and backend services.

I enjoy creating solution to a wide range of problems including in game animation scripting, backend services, UI/UX among other things. I have experience in creating software for both internal and external customers

My hobbies include running and triathlons and have recently finished my first Ultra-Marathon and half Iron Man!

positions.title: Freelance Programmer
positions.description:
+Created a continuous integration pipeline for delivering game installer to client using a combination of Bitbucket pipelines, Unity Cloud Build, and AWS
+Worked closely with clients to establish problem specifications and system designs to create multiple high-quality prototypes in a short period of time
+Designed and implemented a Python application for communication between host software and the Unity3D game

positions.title: Unity3D Team Lead/Software Developer
positions.description:
+Led a group of 5 engineers in the design and development of Unity3D-based educational software solutions
+Built, tested and deployed 3-5 releases a year for 3 products with a 100,000+ user base
+Streamlined deployment process by developing a continuous integration workflow using TeamCity and Jenkins
+Improved code quality by implementing code review and code quality guidelines using both automated tools and processes
+ Implemented an innovative and scalable system for storing user data
+Performed regression and system-level testing to verify software quality and function before release
+Balanced deliverables on multiple teams with rapidly changing priorities using multiple technologies and platforms

positions.title: Production Lead
positions.description:
Production Lead for events such as Sesame Street Live and Daniel Tosh gave me experience in dealing
with tour managers and artists to make events run smoothly
Responsible for all technical parts of Gator Woman’s basketball and being a main contact person for the
University Athletic Association during the 2011-2012 season
Gained experience in troubleshooting problems and solving them on a very constricted schedule
Helped maintain and repair the technical equipment at the O’Connell center

positions.title: Gator Growl Production Lead
positions.description:
Experience in scheduling hundreds of employees and multiple contractors to accomplish tasks on a very
tight schedule
Experience in working on a limited budget to get gear required to make Gator Growl possible
Organized two years of this event.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description: Audio Technician for multiple events across the Gainesville, FL area and for home University of Florida football games

positions.title: File Clerk and Courier
positions.description:
Began as a file clerk and was quickly promoted to courier while in high school
As courier I gained experience in prioritizing, time management, and personal responsibility
